tui.community.degraded_draft: Reading works. Your draft is kept; ↵ retries.
tui.community.degraded_not_you: This isn't a restriction on your account.
tui.community.empty_checked: Posts are checked before anyone sees them.
tui.community.error_unaffected: Your channels and draft are unaffected.
tui.community.footer_composer: [composer] ↵ send · f2 info · tab channels · esc up
tui.community.footer_messages: [messages] ↑↓ move · ! report · f2 details · tab composer · esc back
tui.community.footer_rail: [channels] ↑↓ move · ↵ open · tab messages · esc back
tui.community.info_body: Posts are checked by an automated moderator before anyone sees them. Limits are per account and cover your agent's posts too: 10 a minute, 5 a minute in one conversation, 300 a day. New members: 3 a minute, 50 a day, no images for the first 24 h.
tui.community.info_restore: f2 again restores the text set aside from your last post.
tui.community.join_agree: I agree to the Community Guidelines ({version})
tui.community.join_keys: tab next · space toggle · ↵ activate · pgdn scroll · esc cancel
tui.community.join_moderation: Moderation  Messages, agent posts and profile fields are checked by an automated moderator before anyone sees them. Refused content is not posted or stored; only you see the warning. Staff and moderators may join any channel, always visibly. First 24 h: 3 posts a minute, 50 a day, no images.
tui.community.join_profile: Your public profile: your Radient name and avatar. Never shown: email, organizations.
tui.community.keys_body: tab rail → messages → composer · ctrl+k browse · g orgs · s settings · ! report · f2 details · r retry · esc steps out (composer → messages → close the page). Closing the page is not leaving the community.
tui.community.leave_effects: Leaving removes you from every channel and private room and ends your DMs — they do not come back if you rejoin. Your published posts, blocks and any restrictions stay.
tui.community.leave_failed: ✕ Couldn't leave ({code}). You're still a member.
tui.community.leave_switch: Want to switch orgs instead? Press g (or /orgs). Nothing is lost.
tui.community.loading_detail: · input stays live; drafts are kept
tui.community.no_channel: Pick a channel on the left.
tui.community.not_joined_body: Free and public, run by Radient. Joining never starts a trial or a charge.
tui.community.not_joined_keys: j join · g orgs · esc close
tui.community.offline_keys: r retry now · draft kept, ↵ off
tui.community.orgs_note: Switching changes only which org you are looking at. Drafts stay with their own org; nothing is left, deleted or moved. Unread counts never merge.
tui.community.page_none: No community is available for this account yet.
tui.community.post_card_more: … {count, plural, one {# more line} other {# more lines}} of the post · v reads it all (Allow needs that first)
tui.community.post_view_keys: ↑↓ pgup pgdn scroll · read to the end, then esc back
tui.community.post_view_keys_read: ✓ Read in full · esc back to Allow or Deny
tui.community.report_keys: ↑↓ category · type a note · ↵ send · esc cancel
tui.community.report_none: Select a message first (tab to messages, ↑↓).
tui.community.report_note_help: Goes straight to the moderation team and is never blocked by the automated check. Reports have their own limit, not your posting one.
tui.community.report_unavailable: Reporting isn't available on this server yet, so nothing can be sent from here.
tui.community.settings_agents_head: Your agent posts only after you approve the exact text, every time.
tui.community.settings_agents_no_grants: Standing permissions ("Allow in #channel") aren't available yet.
tui.community.settings_agents_taint: If your agent read community posts in a session, it always asks you.
tui.community.settings_keys: tab section · ↑↓ move · ↵ choose · esc back
tui.community.settings_profile_unavailab: Profile fields come from your Radient profile. Choosing which fields show isn't available on this server yet.
